articles.title: Major Companies Neglect Web Client Quality: Strategies to Enhance User Experience and Functionality
articles.excerpt: Introduction: The Decline of Web Client Investment It’s no secret that major tech companies are pouring resources into mobile apps, but at what cost? The web clients of platforms like Instagram and Re…
articles.body: Introduction: The Decline of Web Client Investment It’s no secret that major tech companies are pouring resources into mobile apps, but at what cost? The web clients of platforms like Instagram and Reddit are crumbling under neglect, and the evidence is painfully clear. Take Instagram’s web client, for instance. Users report buttons that fail to respond , pages that refuse to load without a full refresh , and video playback glitches that carry over from one clip to the next. These aren’t minor inconveniences—they’re symptoms of a deeper issue. The causal chain is straightforward: reduced investment in web client development leads to accumulated technical debt , which in turn degrades functionality and frustrates users . Reddit’s web client isn’t faring much better.

articles.body: Google Search Console now has dedicated Generative AI performance reports for measuring a website's appearances in Google's AI search experiences. The reports separate visibility in AI Overviews and AI Mode from the rest of Search Console reporting, giving site owners a first-party view of how often their pages appear in these generative surfaces. As described in Google's official announcement of Generative AI performance reports , the new reporting surface is built around impressions, not a complete replacement for standard Search Console performance data. articles.title: Building a Pi Extension with Jev: Agent Hooks, Supervision, and Real Tests
articles.excerpt: My coding agent can edit files, run tests, and keep working without me. The harder question is whether it is still working toward the right thing. Suppose I ask for a configuration parser that rejects…
articles.body: My coding agent can edit files, run tests, and keep working without me. The harder question is whether it is still working toward the right thing. Suppose I ask for a configuration parser that rejects unknown settings . The agent decides to accept them instead. It can implement that decision perfectly, write tests for it, and announce success. The code works; the requirement was lost. I built Jev Loop Control to explore whether a second model could catch problems like this at useful moments in a Pi session. Pi runs the tools, the actor writes the code, and Jev assesses selected decisions and evidence. Extension code decides what happens next. The control paths work in tests. The experiments do not yet establish that it makes coding outcomes better.

Sure, we all love being first in line to try out the latest tech, and sometimes that also means getting first dibs on new software designed to take advantage of it. The New Glenn 9×4 launch service will be available to NASA’s Launch Services Program Office to use for future missions. The NLS II contracts are multiple-award, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contracts with an ordering period through June 2030, and an overall period of performance through December 2032.
